memorypool-owned-buffers.title: Rent owned buffers with MemoryPool<T>
memorypool-owned-buffers.short: Represent reusable buffer lifetime with IMemoryOwner<T>
memorypool-owned-buffers.summary: MemoryPool<T> rents reusable storage exposed as Memory<T> and returns it when the IMemoryOwner<T> is disposed.
memorypool-owned-buffers.why: It provides explicit buffer ownership for asynchronous I/O and other operations that cannot retain Span<T>, without allocating a large array each time.
memorypool-owned-buffers.tips: The returned memory may be larger than requested, so use only the required slice and always dispose the owner.

exceptiondispatchinfo-preserve-stack.title: Rethrow later while preserving exception stack information with ExceptionDispatchInfo
exceptiondispatchinfo-preserve-stack.short: Capture an exception and throw it later without losing its original failure history
exceptiondispatchinfo-preserve-stack.summary: ExceptionDispatchInfo captures an exception together with dispatch information and can rethrow it later through Throw.
exceptiondispatchinfo-preserve-stack.why: It preserves the original failure location better than throwing the caught exception object again from another location.
exceptiondispatchinfo-preserve-stack.tips: Use throw; for an immediate rethrow in the same catch block; use ExceptionDispatchInfo when the exception must cross a boundary before rethrowing.

periodictimer-async-loop.title: Run cancellable periodic asynchronous work with PeriodicTimer
periodictimer-async-loop.short: Await each timer tick inside a normal async loop
periodictimer-async-loop.summary: PeriodicTimer exposes the next tick as a ValueTask<bool>, making periodic work fit naturally with async code and CancellationToken.
periodictimer-async-loop.why: For sequential periodic work it is easier to reason about than callback timers and reduces accidental overlapping callbacks.
periodictimer-async-loop.tips: Decide what should happen when work takes longer than the period and dispose the timer when the loop ends.

assemblydependencyresolver-plugin-loadin.title: Resolve plugin dependencies with AssemblyDependencyResolver
assemblydependencyresolver-plugin-loadin.short: Use a plugin's dependency metadata to locate managed and native files
assemblydependencyresolver-plugin-loadin.summary: AssemblyDependencyResolver resolves managed assemblies and native libraries from the dependency information associated with a plugin component.
assemblydependencyresolver-plugin-loadin.why: It lets a custom AssemblyLoadContext follow .NET dependency metadata instead of inventing filename search rules.
assemblydependencyresolver-plugin-loadin.tips: Pair it with a dedicated AssemblyLoadContext and avoid loading shared contract assemblies twice.

httpclient-lifetime-socket-exhaustion.title: Do not create a new HttpClient for every request
httpclient-lifetime-socket-exhaustion.short: Reuse HTTP clients so their connection pools can be reused
httpclient-lifetime-socket-exhaustion.summary: Creating and disposing short-lived HttpClient instances repeatedly interferes with connection reuse and makes socket and DNS lifetime behavior harder to manage.
httpclient-lifetime-socket-exhaustion.why: Under load it can waste ephemeral ports and connection setup work, eventually contributing to communication failures.
httpclient-lifetime-socket-exhaustion.tips: Use a long-lived HttpClient or IHttpClientFactory and configure connection lifetime on SocketsHttpHandler when needed.

pinned-object-heap-buffers.title: Use the Pinned Object Heap for long-lived pinned buffers
pinned-object-heap-buffers.short: Allocate arrays directly as pinned when a stable address is required
pinned-object-heap-buffers.summary: GC.AllocateArray with pinned enabled allocates an array on the Pinned Object Heap so the GC does not move it.
pinned-object-heap-buffers.why: For long-lived interop buffers that require stable addresses, it provides a different tradeoff from pinning ordinary heap objects after allocation.
pinned-object-heap-buffers.tips: Pinned memory restricts GC flexibility, so reserve it for measured long-lived buffers that genuinely require a stable address.

arraypool-sensitive-data.title: Clear sensitive data before returning buffers to ArrayPool
arraypool-sensitive-data.short: Do not leave secrets in storage that will be rented again
arraypool-sensitive-data.summary: Arrays returned to ArrayPool<T> can later be rented by other code, so their previous contents are not automatically confidential.
arraypool-sensitive-data.why: Keys, tokens, or credentials left in a returned buffer may remain observable when that storage is reused.
arraypool-sensitive-data.tips: Zero the sensitive range with CryptographicOperations.ZeroMemory and consider clearArray on Return when appropriate for the data and cost.

fire-and-forget-task-failures.title: Give fire-and-forget Tasks an explicit owner
fire-and-forget-task-failures.short: Ensure someone observes completion and failures of asynchronous work
fire-and-forget-task-failures.summary: Discarding a Task removes the caller's responsibility for observing its exception and completion without assigning that responsibility elsewhere.
fire-and-forget-task-failures.why: Failures can disappear from the request flow, and work may outlive scoped resources that it still depends on.
fire-and-forget-task-failures.tips: Await work when possible; otherwise enqueue it to a supervised background service with explicit lifetime and error handling.

system-diagnostics-metrics-instruments.title: Publish application metrics with System.Diagnostics.Metrics
system-diagnostics-metrics-instruments.short: Expose counters and histograms through a Meter
system-diagnostics-metrics-instruments.summary: System.Diagnostics.Metrics is the standard .NET API for publishing numerical measurements such as counts and durations to observability systems.
system-diagnostics-metrics-instruments.why: Metrics are designed for aggregation and monitoring instead of reconstructing every operational count from log messages.
system-diagnostics-metrics-instruments.tips: Keep tag cardinality bounded; identifiers with nearly unique values can make metric aggregation expensive.

systemtextjson-polymorphism.title: Declare polymorphic contracts explicitly with System.Text.Json
systemtextjson-polymorphism.short: Assign discriminators to the derived types allowed by a base JSON contract
systemtextjson-polymorphism.summary: JsonPolymorphic and JsonDerivedType let a base type serialize known derived types with explicit type discriminators.
systemtextjson-polymorphism.why: The accepted runtime types become part of the JSON contract instead of relying on unrestricted runtime type discovery.
systemtextjson-polymorphism.tips: Treat discriminator values as stable public contract data and do not resolve arbitrary type names supplied by untrusted JSON.
